+class _CarLinePainter extends CustomPainter {
+  @override
+  void paint(Canvas canvas, Size size) {
+    final white = Paint()
+      ..color = Colors.white
+      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
+      ..strokeWidth = 2.2
+      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
+
+    final red = Paint()
+      ..color = const Color(0xFFE8323C)
+      ..style = PaintingStyle.stroke
+      ..strokeWidth = 2.6
+      ..strokeCap = StrokeCap.round;
+
+    final p1 = Path()
+      ..moveTo(size.width * 0.08, size.height * 0.72)
+      ..cubicTo(
+        size.width * 0.24,
+        size.height * 0.30,
+        size.width * 0.50,
+        size.height * 0.12,
+        size.width * 0.78,
+        size.height * 0.48,
+      )
+      ..cubicTo(
+        size.width * 0.86,
+        size.height * 0.58,
+        size.width * 0.92,
+        size.height * 0.66,
+        size.width * 0.96,
+        size.height * 0.72,
+      );
+
+    final p2 = Path()
+      ..moveTo(size.width * 0.20, size.height * 0.71)
+      ..cubicTo(
+        size.width * 0.38,
+        size.height * 0.55,
+        size.width * 0.55,
+        size.height * 0.50,
+        size.width * 0.76,
+        size.height * 0.66,
+      );
+
+    final p3 = Path()
+      ..moveTo(size.width * 0.58, size.height * 0.28)
+      ..cubicTo(
+        size.width * 0.66,
+        size.height * 0.22,
+        size.width * 0.73,
+        size.height * 0.25,
+        size.width * 0.82,
+        size.height * 0.40,
+      );
+
+    canvas.drawPath(p1, white);
+    canvas.drawPath(p2, white);
+    canvas.drawPath(p3, red);
+  }
+
+  @override
+  bool shouldRepaint(covariant CustomPainter oldDelegate) => false;
+}
